payload.title: Sankranti Millet & Dry Fruit Laddus: A Wholesome, Energy-Boosting Treat for the Festive Season
payload.content:
Sankranti Millet & Dry Fruit Laddus: A Wholesome, Energy-Boosting Treat for the Festive Season

As the vibrant festival of Sankranti approaches, marking the sun's journey into Makara and the onset of longer days, families across India prepare to celebrate with traditional foods that nourish the body and soul. This season, often coinciding with cooler weather and a need for sustained energy, calls for wholesome treats that align with both cultural heritage and modern health consciousness. Our 'Sankranti Millet & Dry Fruit Laddus' offer a perfect blend of tradition, nutrition, and convenience, featuring Roshini's Nutrimix to provide an energy boost that supports overall well-being.

These laddus are designed not just as a festive indulgence but as a powerhouse of essential nutrients. Incorporating Roshini's Nutrimix, which combines sprouted ragi, sprouted jowar, sprouted green gram, roasted almonds, cashews, and cardamom, these laddus deliver complex carbohydrates, protein, healthy fats, and dietary fiber. This unique blend ensures a steady release of energy, making them an ideal snack for busy professionals and active parents navigating the festive season and seasonal changes. They embody a commitment to preventive health, boosting immunity naturally, and maintaining vitality with an easy-to-prepare option that respects traditional values while fitting seamlessly into a contemporary lifestyle.

Recipe Details

  • Prep Time: 25 minutes
  • Cook Time: 15 minutes
  • Servings: 12-14 laddus

Nutrition Table (per Laddu, estimated)

NutrientAmount
Calories185 kcal
Protein5.2 g
Carbohydrates24.8 g
Fats8.5 g
Fiber3.1 g

Ingredients

  • 1 cup Roshini's Nutrimix
  • ½ cup grated jaggery (adjust to taste)
  • ¼ cup water
  • 3 tablespoons ghee (clarified butter)
  • ¼ cup mixed dry fruits (chopped dates, figs, raisins, pistachios)
  • ½ teaspoon extra cardamom powder (optional, for enhanced aroma)
  • A pinch of salt (to balance sweetness)

Instructions

  1. Lightly Toast Nutrimix: In a heavy-bottomed pan, dry roast Roshini's Nutrimix on low-medium heat for 3-5 minutes until a fragrant aroma emerges. Be careful not to burn it. Transfer to a large mixing bowl and allow to cool slightly.
  2. Prepare Jaggery Syrup: In the same pan, combine grated jaggery and water. Heat on low flame, stirring continuously until the jaggery completely melts and forms a thick, sticky syrup. This should take about 5-7 minutes. Ensure no lumps remain.
  3. Add Ghee and Dry Fruits: Reduce the heat to very low. Add the ghee to the jaggery syrup and mix well. Then, stir in the chopped mixed dry fruits, optional extra cardamom powder, and a pinch of salt. Cook for another 1-2 minutes, allowing the dry fruits to soften slightly.
  4. Combine and Mix: Pour the hot jaggery-ghee mixture immediately into the bowl with the roasted Nutrimix. Using a sturdy spoon or spatula, mix thoroughly until the Nutrimix is evenly coated and a sticky dough-like consistency forms.
  5. Form Laddus: While the mixture is still warm enough to handle (but not too hot), lightly grease your palms with a little ghee. Take small portions of the mixture and press firmly, shaping them into tight, round laddus of desired size. Work quickly as the mixture will harden as it cools.
  6. Cool and Serve: Place the formed laddus on a plate or tray and allow them to cool completely at room temperature. Once cooled, they will firm up further.

Chef Tips for Perfect Laddus

  • Temperature is Key: Ensure the jaggery syrup is hot when mixed with Nutrimix. This helps bind the laddus properly. However, let the mixture cool just enough so it's manageable to handle without burning your hands.
  • Ghee for Shine and Flavor: Don't skimp on ghee. It not only adds a rich flavor but also helps in binding the laddus and gives them a desirable sheen.
  • Firm Compression: When shaping the laddus, compress the mixture firmly between your palms. This prevents them from crumbling later.
  • Nutrimix Roasting: The light roasting of Nutrimix enhances its flavor and aroma, contributing to a more delicious final product. Watch carefully to avoid over-roasting.

Storage Instructions

Once cooled, store the Sankranti Millet & Dry Fruit Laddus in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 7-10 days. For extended freshness, they can be refrigerated for up to 2-3 weeks. Ensure they are completely cool before storing to prevent moisture buildup.

Variations

  • Vegan Option: Replace ghee with an equal amount of coconut oil or a neutral-flavored plant-based butter. Ensure your jaggery is free from animal-derived processing aids.
  • Gluten-Free: Roshini's Nutrimix is inherently gluten-free, making these laddus a naturally safe option for those avoiding gluten.
  • Flavor Boost: For an extra layer of warmth, add a pinch of dry ginger powder or nutmeg along with the cardamom.
  • Nut & Seed Medley: Experiment with adding other finely chopped nuts like walnuts or pecans, or seeds such as chia seeds or flax seeds for added texture and nutritional value.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  1. Can I adjust the sweetness of these laddus?
    Yes, the amount of jaggery can be adjusted to your preference. Start with ½ cup and add more if you prefer a sweeter laddu, or reduce slightly for a less sweet version.
  2. How long do these laddus typically last?
    When stored in an airtight container at room temperature, these laddus stay fresh for about 7-10 days. Refrigeration can extend their shelf life to 2-3 weeks.
  3. Can I make these laddus without jaggery?
    While jaggery provides a unique flavor and binding property, you can experiment with alternatives like date syrup or maple syrup. However, the consistency might vary, and you may need to adjust the liquid content to achieve the right binding.
